title: Signs of the End of the Age

questions.question: As Jesus left the temple, His disciples pointed out the temple buildings to Him. What did Jesus prophesy about those buildings?
options: "There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
"These stones will last until the end of the age."
"The Romans will take this temple back to Rome."
"The fire of heaven will scorch these rocks."
questions.correctAnswer: "There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:2 (ESV): "But he answered them, 'You see all these, do you not? Truly, I say to you, there will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down.'"

questions.question: As Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives, what two questions did the disciples ask Him privately?
options: "When will these things be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"
"Why must the temple fall, and who will rebuild it?"
"When will you overthrow the Romans, and where?"
"Who among us will betray you, and how?"
questions.correctAnswer: "When will these things be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:3 (ESV): "...the disciples came to him privately, saying, 'Tell us, when will these things be, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?'"

questions.question: Jesus warned them first to see that no one leads them astray. For many will come in His name saying what?
options: "I am the Christ," and they will lead many astray
"I bring peace from God"
"I have the power of Moses"
"The end is near!"
questions.correctAnswer: "I am the Christ," and they will lead many astray
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:5 (ESV): "For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Christ,' and they will lead many astray."

questions.question: Jesus mentioned they would hear of wars and rumors of wars, famines, and earthquakes. He said all these are but the beginning of what?
options: The birth pains
The Tribulation
The day of the Lord
The great wrath
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:8 (ESV): "All these are but the beginning of the birth pains."

questions.question: Because lawlessness will be increased, what will happen to the love of many?
options: It will grow cold
It will turn to hate
It will be hidden
It will burn fiercely
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:12 (ESV): "And because lawlessness will be increased, the love of many will grow cold."

questions.question: What must happen to the gospel of the kingdom before the end will come?
options: It will be proclaimed throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations
It will be written down in books for all to read
It must be accepted by the leaders of Rome
It will be shouted from the temple roof
questions.correctAnswer: It will be proclaimed throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:14 (ESV): "And this gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come."

questions.question: Jesus told those in Judea to flee to the mountains when they see the "abomination of desolation." Which prophet spoke of this?
options: Daniel
Ezekiel
Isaiah
Jeremiah
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:15 (ESV): "So when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of by the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place..."

questions.question: If anyone says "Look, here is the Christ!" or "There he is!", why should they not believe it?
options: Because false christs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders
Because the true Christ will be in the temple entirely
Because Christ is a spirit in heaven
Because no one can ever see the Christ again
questions.correctAnswer: Because false christs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:24 (ESV): "For false christs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect."

questions.question: How visible will the real coming of the Son of Man be?
options: As the lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man
It will be hidden like a thief in the night without warning
Only the righteous will see it with their eyes
It will begin in a remote desert cave
questions.correctAnswer: As the lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:27 (ESV): "For as the lightning comes from the east and shines as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man."

questions.question: Immediately after the tribulation of those days, what will happen to the sun, moon, and stars?
options: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven
The sun will burn twice as hot, the moon will turn to blood
They will crash into the earth violently
They will remain unchanged while the earth shakes
questions.correctAnswer: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:29 (ESV): "...the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall from heaven..."

questions.question: Then will appear in heaven the sign of the Son of Man, and He will come on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. Who will He send out with a loud trumpet call to gather His elect?
options: His angels
The twelve apostles
King David's army
The righteous martyrs
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:31 (ESV): "And he will send out his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds..."

questions.question: What lesson does Jesus teach from the fig tree?
options: As soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near
When its fruit is rotten, winter is coming
When it is cursed, it produces no more fruit forever
Its roots are deeper than the oak
questions.correctAnswer: As soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:32 (ESV): "From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near."

questions.question: Heaven and earth will pass away, but what will by no means pass away?
options: "But my words will not pass away."
"But the souls of the righteous will not pass away."
"But the law of Moses will not pass away."
"But the holy city of Jerusalem will not pass away."
questions.correctAnswer: "But my words will not pass away."
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:35 (ESV): "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away."

questions.question: Regarding the exact day and hour of His return, who knows it?
options: No one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only
Only the Son of Man knows
Only the high priest and the prophets know
Satan knows but hides the truth
questions.correctAnswer: No one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:36 (ESV): "But concerning that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only."

questions.question: Jesus compares the coming of the Son of Man to the days of whom, when people were eating, drinking, and marrying, unaware until the flood came?
options: The days of Noah
The days of Lot
The days of Moses
The days of David
questions.explanation: Matthew 24:37 (ESV): "For as were the days of Noah, so will be the coming of the Son of Man."

key_verse_text: "Therefore you also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect."
